title: Tomorrow at Eight daily record
description: One file per development day: TomorrowAtEight/Assets/TomorrowAtEight/Data/Days/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Every key is always present, in this order.

date.description: UTC date; equals the file name.

day.description: Day number. Day 0 is the foundation build.

title.description: Short title without the day number.

author.description: Reddit name of the prompt's author, or "" if unknown.

prompt.description: What was asked: the exact selected prompt, unchanged.

done.description: What was done, one plain sentence each, in player terms.

details.description: Optional: details worth sharing about how the day went or how it works.

suggestions.description: Optional: ideas for the next prompts. Ideas only, not decisions.
